# Ryan Allen

> Ryan Allen is a designer who has worked with GoDaddy on domain search and AI, Blackboard on Scholar, Lexus, Spectrum, Transamerica, Microsoft, BMW, Disney and Google Ventures, made Leaftext, and is a repeat guest on The Howard Stern Show.

Ryan designs products from the first idea to production code: research, UX, AI products, design systems, hardware-connected apps, and the teams that build them.

## Work

- [GoDaddy](https://ryanallen.com/#godaddy): Led design on the domain buy flow and helped build AI domain search from a hackathon prototype. Ryan designs systems that orchestrate agents through research, design and development, uses them to ship production work as a designer, and teaches teams how to work this way. Work also includes GoDaddy in ChatGPT with OpenAI, a Google UX initiative and voice search.
- [Scholar](https://ryanallen.com/#scholar): An AI study platform for college students, from Blackboard. Ryan led design and product from 0 to 1 and beyond, worked on early branding, and wrote agent rules and skills for design docs, coded prototypes and development handoff. He reviewed engineers' PRs against those designs. His work also includes research, the roadmap, hiring and code shipped to production.
- [Leaftext](https://leaftext.com/): A free, open-source desktop app for reading and writing your own files, Office and Google Workspace files included, with AI agents working inside it and agent harnesses holding them to your checks.
- [Transamerica](https://ryanallen.com/#transamerica): Designed a system for financial advisors to send regulatory mailings, worked with outside mailing houses, helped contractor developers adopt the design system, and trained the team to use AI in their work.
- [Charter / Spectrum](https://ryanallen.com/#charter): A zero-to-one app, with hardware and backend services, for older adults and the people who look after them.
- [Lexus](https://ryanallen.com/#lexus): The Lexus IS iPad app, built by the studio team on a custom 3D engine and released on the App Store. Gold ADDY.
- [Monsters Invade Oz](https://ryanallen.com/#monsters-invade-oz): A mobile game that reached the top 10 free games on the iOS App Store. Ryan built and led the team and illustrated and animated its 15,000-plus assets. GDC Best in Play.
- [Dapper Gentlemen](https://ryanallen.com/#dapper-gentlemen): A studio Ryan co-founded and ran. Its apps reached #1 across the Apple App Store and Google Play, including the free and paid iPad charts. Its own apps were downloaded more than 30 million times in 94 countries; clients included Microsoft, BMW, Disney and Google Ventures. Acquired by HIPO.

## Independent projects

- [Steer](https://ryanallen.com/steer/): A playable interface for working with an AI agent: edit its plan before anything runs, watch every action in words, steer it mid-run without starting over, approve the one action that can't be undone, and review each change by the step that made it, with the checks and a before-and-after preview as evidence. [How it's designed](https://ryanallen.com/steer/about.html).
- [Spacewar Live](https://spacewarlive.com/): A remake of the 1985 DOS Spacewar, online in the browser.
- [Voynich Research](https://ryanallen.com/voynich/research.html): Ryan trained a model to trace the Voynich manuscript. People are checking thousands of words, and the research examines its pictures, writing, scribes and proposed readings. [Trace the Voynich](https://ryanallen.com/voynich/) invites people to help correct the tracing.
- [Wallet Wars](https://ryanallen.com/walletwars/): A terminal-style crypto trading game.
- [Design Canvas](https://ryanallen.com/design-canvas/): A board that lays HTML prototypes side by side, to view, play, edit and comment on them as HTML and CSS, with every edit written back into the prototype.
- [Chenrezig](https://ryanallen.com/chenrezig/): A Tibetan prayer-wheel temple for H.E. Garchen Rinpoche's Chenrezig empowerment, ray traced in a WebGL2 shader in one hand-written page with no 3D library: turn the wheel, read the teaching and watch the empowerment.
